steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is available.
Provide the required project title.
Create the required Technical plus RFQ stage pair.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required RFQ line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor for the vendor-portal check.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the event's Technical stage in the vendor portal.
Verify the RFQ-only clause is not shown on the Technical stage.
Verify the second RFQ-only clause is not shown on the Technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage where the mandatory clauses apply.
Verify the first mandatory RFQ clause is presented to the vendor.
Verify the second mandatory RFQ clause is presented to the vendor.
Accept only one of the two mandatory clauses.
Attempt to submit a quote after accepting only one clause; submission must be blocked because the other mandatory clause remains unaccepted.
